run.name: c1-halfmoonbay-oneline
run.notes: The Half Moon Bay shoreline south of the Pillar Point Harbor breakwater, 1961 to 2025, on a one-line model with the reanalysis waves and the structures' shadows; today's shoreline, so rates are measured, not positions; the transport coefficient and the leak through the breakwater fitted to the Corps' rates and declared; everything else recalled or guessed; not a fluid dynamics model.
